archimate:ApplicationService.name: product
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation: Defined as the foundational building block of service delivery, comprising both tangible (e.g., servers, hardware, code) and intangible (e.g., support resources, user interfaces) components. Products consist of an organization's resources, which include: Information & Technology: Code, networks, software applications, and data storage. People & Organizations: The skill sets, support staff, and organizational structure required to maintain the product. Value Streams & Processes: The workflows and practices utilized to build, deliver, and support the product. Partners & Suppliers: Third-party components or cloud resources bundled into the final offering. Products connect the technical architecture (code, services, infrastructure) with the organizational structure (dev teams, product managers) to deliver customer value, enabling a product-based approach to a SaaS platform or cloud service. Products may be consumed by one or more business services.
